newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Christopher calls for talks, end to Burundi war.
newsitem.headline: Christopher calls for talks, end to Burundi war.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher called on Friday for an end to Burundi's ethnic war and urged its warring groups to begin all-party peace negotiations.
At a news conference after talks on Burundi with East African leaders, Christopher said the international community should be ready to act if the situation deteriorated.
"The United States calls on both sides in the conflict to suspend their hostilities and to begin all-party negotiations," Christopher said.
The ethnic war in Burundi pits the country's Tutsi-dominated army against Hutu rebels.
Christopher alerted the international community, blamed for failing to take action to prevent genocide in neighbouring Rwanda in 1994, to be prepared for action in Burundi should diplomacy fail.

"With good faith on all sides we believe a peaceful settlement is attainable. Should the situation in Burundi deteriorate further, however, the international community must be prepared to act quickly to prevent a humanitarian catastrophe," he added.
